title: Pabasta e zanjeer
body:
pabastae zanjeer ke chehre ko bhi dekho
ay sham ke baazariyo lehje ko bhi dekho
<<DIVIDER>>
lehje may wohi faatahe khyber ki garaj hai
karaar ki jaraar ki safdar ki garaj hai
pyase ke garajte hue khutbe ko bhi dekho
pabastae zanjeer…
<<DIVIDER>>
wo sar ke jo naize pe tilawat may hai mashghool
wo sar to azal se bhi ibadat may hai mashghool
us sar ke zara khaak may sajde ko bhi dekho
pabastae zanjeer…
<<DIVIDER>>
sab log ye kis sar ki ziarat ke liye hai
shayad ke payambar ki ziarat ke liye hai
hamshakle payambar ke kaleje ko bhi dekho
pabastae zanjeer…
<<DIVIDER>>
nanha sa wo ek sar bhi sare noke sina hai
jispe ke faqat teer se katne ka nishan hai
be-ghairaton cheh maah ke bache ko bhi dekho
pabastae zanjeer…
<<DIVIDER>>
maidan may bilakte hue bachon ko to dekha
shabbir ke jalte hue qaimon ko to dekha
naizon se ridaon ke utarne ko bhi dekho
pabastae zanjeer…
<<DIVIDER>>
honton pe bhatiji ke raha naam chacha ka
is naam ne har dukh may diya kaam dawa ka
is naam pe zaalim ke tamache ko bhi dekho
pabastae zanjeer…
<<DIVIDER>>
shahid hai falak door bahot aur zameen sakht
bazaar se darbar ki manzil hai kahin sakht
is baat pe zainab ke tadapne ko bhi dekho
pabastae zanjeer…
author: Shahid Jafer
